verses.text: I commend unto you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreæ:
verses.line: 1:I commend unto you Phoebe our sister who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreæ

verses.text: that ye receive her in the Lord, worthily of the saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you: for she herself also hath been a helper of many, and of mine own self.
verses.line: 2:that ye receive her in the Lord worthily of the saints and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you for she herself also hath been a helper of many and of mine own self

verses.text: Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow-workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.line: 3:Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow workers in Christ Jesus

verses.text: who for my life laid down their own necks; unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles:
verses.line: 4:who for my life laid down their own necks unto whom not only I give thanks but also all the churches of the Gentiles

verses.text: and salute the church that is in their house. Salute Epænetus my beloved, who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ.
verses.line: 5:and salute the church that is in their house Salute Epænetus my beloved who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ

verses.text: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.
verses.line: 6:Salute Mary who bestowed much labor on you

verses.text: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.
verses.line: 7:Salute Andronicus and Junias my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners who are of note among the apostles who also have been in Christ before me

verses.text: Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.
verses.line: 8:Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord

verses.text: Salute Urbanus our fellow-worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.line: 9:Salute Urbanus our fellow worker in Christ and Stachys my beloved

verses.text: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the household of Aristobulus.
verses.line: 10:Salute Apelles the approved in Christ Salute them that are of the household of Aristobulus

verses.text: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the household of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.
verses.line: 11:Salute Herodion my kinsman Salute them of the household of Narcissus that are in the Lord

verses.text: Salute Tryphæna and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
verses.line: 12:Salute Tryphæna and Tryphosa who labor in the Lord Salute Persis the beloved who labored much in the Lord

verses.text: Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.line: 13:Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord and his mother and mine

verses.text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren that are with them.
verses.line: 14:Salute Asyncritus Phlegon Hermes Patrobas Hermas and the brethren that are with them

verses.text: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints that are with them.
verses.line: 15:Salute Philologus and Julia Nereus and his sister and Olympas and all the saints that are with them

verses.text: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.
verses.line: 16:Salute one another with a holy kiss All the churches of Christ salute you

verses.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.
verses.line: 17:Now I beseech you brethren mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling contrary to the doctrine which ye learned and turn away from them

verses.text: For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.
verses.line: 18:For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ but their own belly and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent

verses.text: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I rejoice therefore over you: but I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple unto that which is evil.
verses.line: 19:For your obedience is come abroad unto all men I rejoice therefore over you but I would have you wise unto that which is good and simple unto that which is evil

verses.text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.line: 20:And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you

verses.text: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
verses.line: 21:Timothy my fellow worker saluteth you and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater my kinsmen

verses.text: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.line: 22:I Tertius who write the epistle salute you in the Lord

verses.text: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you, and Quartus the brother.
verses.line: 23:Gaius my host and of the whole church saluteth you Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you and Quartus the brother

verses.text: Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal,
verses.line: 25:Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal

verses.text: but now is manifested, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith:
verses.line: 26:but now is manifested and by the scriptures of the prophets according to the commandment of the eternal God is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith

verses.text: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.
verses.line: 27:to the only wise God through Jesus Christ to whom be the glory for ever Amen
